content.title: About
content.content: Fruit smoothie, NFS is a ready‑to‑drink fruit smoothie made from selected ripe fruits, berries and natural juices. It contains no artificial colors, flavors or preservatives and is fortified with vitamins and minerals to support energy and immunity.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The blend includes more than 10 fruit varieties, such as mango, pineapple, kiwi and acai berries.
One serving provides about 150% of the daily recommended vitamin C.
The product was developed under the NFS (Nutri‑Fruit Solution) program for rapid post‑workout recovery.
The mix is completely vegan and gluten‑free.
Packaging is made from recyclable plastic, reducing environmental impact.

items.title: Rich in antioxidants
items.content: The fruit composition delivers a high level of antioxidants that help combat free radicals.

items.title: Immune support
items.content: Vitamin C and other micronutrients contribute to a stronger immune system.

items.title: Energy boost
items.content: Natural fruit sugars quickly replenish muscle glycogen stores.

items.title: Hydration
items.content: The blend contains over 80% water, aiding overall body hydration.

items.title: Digestive aid
items.content: Fruit fiber supports healthy bowel function and promotes satiety.

items.title: Fruit allergy
items.content: Individuals allergic to specific fruits (e.g., kiwi or strawberry) may experience reactions.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Despite being natural, the product contains a notable amount of sugar and may not be suitable for people with diabetes.

items.title: Acidity
items.content: High acidity of certain fruits can cause discomfort for those with a sensitive stomach.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Drink the ready‑to‑consume smoothie chilled, straight from the bottle. Optionally add ice, mint, or a protein powder to increase nutritional value.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in the refrigerator at 2 °C–6 °C. Once opened, consume within 3‑5 days. Do not freeze, as the texture may change.
